figurative_meaning_bn: যা অল্পকালের জন্য থাকে বা সাময়িক
figurative_meaning_en: Something that is short-lived or temporary
example_sentences_in_bangla: এই সাফল্যটা সন্ধ্যাপ্রদীপের মতো, শীঘ্রই মিলিয়ে যাবে।
example_sentences_in_english: This success is like an evening lamp; it will fade away soon.
His promises are like evening lamps, temporary and fleeting.
history: Refers to the traditional Bengali practice of lighting oil lamps at dusk for evening worship of deities, symbolizing brevity.
note: The idiom draws from everyday Hindu rituals in Bengali culture.
